newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ sees NZ sustainable growth rate at 2.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ sees NZ sustainable growth rate at 2.75 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Tuesday that its view of New Zealand's sustainable economic growth rate was unchanged at 2.75 percent.
The banks's projections, in its December monetary Policy statement, were finalised before the formation of the National- New Zealand First Party coalition government last week.
The new government said the bank must target sustainable growth as well as price stability, previously its only economic target.
Treasury in its pre-election briefing in September put sustainable growth at 3.5 percent.
